title_en: The 41st Division of the Army's Community Relations Unit, together with local leaders, went on to care for vulnerable people with heart.
summary_en: On October 31, 2569 at 11:00 a.m. the Special Task Force of the 41st Ranger Regiment with its 4112th Ranger Company and Civil Affairs Task Force members together with local community leaders visited vulnerable people in No. 101/3 Ban Baon Badon Village, Group 2, Gottorak Township, Raman District, Yala Province to provide them with food supplies for their families.
